第2085章 齐聚一堂（第1页）
就在萧天努力修炼的时候，关于萧天的事迹也是在不断的传播。
如今整个诸天万界都知道了萧天这一号人物。
这并不是萧天有多出名，是因为跟萧天战斗的林无敌太过出名。
而能够与林无敌战成平手，那绝对不是一般的天才。
加上林家有意的推波助澜，自然也就是加快了事情的传播。
所以，短短的几天的时间，关于萧天这个名字就传遍了各大势力！
而此刻的萧天并没有关注这方面的事情。
在萧灵和萧珠这里也是用了一个多月的时间。
虽然萧天的修为没有变化，但还是有了一丝丝精进。
当然，对于萧天来说，他并不着急。
但是，这个修炼对于萧天的女人可是有着巨大的好处的。
所以，即便是萧天没有太大的进步也没有关系！
这一次修炼，两个女人也是再次提升了一个境界多，都达到了虚神境二层巅峰。
在萧灵和萧珠那里离开之后，也是再次出现在一个院落之中。
不过现在不仅仅是陈榕倩在，还有聂小青、僵灵以及欧阳月也是在这个房间之中。
她们平时也是一起修炼，他们之间也是有着更多东西可以聊。
一人是妖族、一个是巫族、一个是僵尸一族还有一个是鬼族！

四个女人四个种族，而且还是没有任何关联的那种。
当然，四个女人的关系极为密切，修炼都是一起。
没错，褪去了原来的肉身，修成了圣人之躯。
当然了，原来种族之中好的特性还是保留着。
所以，整体来说，四人的战力也算是萧天女人之中的佼佼者。
而现在四人的修为都已经是达到了虚神境一层后期，这个修为要比水诗诗要强大一些。
距离上一次和萧天修炼也是很长的一段时间。
不过她们也并没有着急去找萧天，毕竟她们不知道萧天有没有时间。
“最近夫君在忙什么呢？”僵灵突然说道。
“谁知道！用诗诗妹妹的话，夫君就是大色狼，大色狼能干什么！不就是在和其他女人在修炼嘛！”陈榕倩笑着说道。
“好像也是！不过这可是夫君重要的修炼方式，我们支持他就少！”欧阳月说道。
“嗯，这话也是在理！就是不知道现在夫君需不需要我们帮忙！”聂小倩笑着说道。
“当然了！我可是非常需要你们的帮忙的！”萧天的声音也是从门外响起。
听到这话，四个女人也是激动的站了起来。然后齐刷刷的看向，门口。
当萧天的身影走了进来的时候，四个女人也是冲上来，投入到萧天的怀中。
“夫君你怎么有时间过来这里！”陈榕倩笑着说道。
“嘿嘿.....当然是感应到你们想我了，然后我就来了！”萧天笑着说道。
“夫君现在也是越来越喜欢开玩笑了。”欧阳月也是笑着说道。
“没有！我说的绝对是真心话！不信你摸摸！”萧天说完之后也是拉着欧阳月的小手放到自己的胸膛之上。
这个动作也是瞬间让欧阳月脸色通红。

而其他女人也是笑着看向萧天......

Chapter 2085 Gathering together (page 1)
While Xiao Tian was working hard to cultivate, stories about Xiao Tian were also constantly spreading.
Now the whole world knows about Xiao Tian.
This is not because Xiao Tian is famous, but because Lin Wudi who fights Xiao Tian is too famous.
And to be able to tie with Lin Wudi, that person is definitely not an ordinary genius.
Coupled with the fact that the Lin family intentionally added fuel to the flames, it naturally accelerated the spread of the matter.
Therefore, in just a few days, the name Xiao Tian spread to all major forces!
At this moment, Xiao Tian was not paying attention to this matter.
It also took more than a month with Xiao Ling and Xiao Zhu.
Although Xiao Tian's cultivation level has not changed, there is still a slight improvement.
Of course, for Xiao Tian, ​​he was not in a hurry.
However, this practice has huge benefits for Xiao Tian's women.
Therefore, it doesn't matter even if Xiao Tian doesn't make much progress!
This time through practice, the two women have once again improved by more than one level, reaching the peak of the second level of the Virtual God Realm.
After leaving Xiao Ling and Xiao Zhu, they appeared in a courtyard again.
But now not only Chen Rongqian is there, but Nie Xiaoqing, Zhan Ling and Ouyang Yue are also in this room.
They usually practice together, and they have more things to talk about.
One is a demon clan, one is a witch clan, one is a zombie clan and one is a ghost clan!
Four women and four races, and they are not related in any way.
Of course, the four women have an extremely close relationship and practice together.
That's right, the original physical body was shed and the body of a saint was cultivated.
Of course, the good characteristics of the original race are still retained.
Therefore, overall, the combat power of the four of them can be regarded as the best among Xiao Tian's women.
And now the cultivation of the four of them has reached the late stage of the first level of Virtual God Realm, which is stronger than Shui Shishi.
It has been a long time since I last practiced with Xiao Tian.
However, they were not in a hurry to find Xiao Tian. After all, they didn't know if Xiao Tian had time.
"What has your husband been busy with recently?" Zhan Ling said suddenly.
"Who knows! In the words of Sister Shishi, a husband is a big pervert. What can a big pervert do? Isn't he just practicing with other women!" Chen Rongqian said with a smile.
"It seems so! But this is an important way of cultivation for your husband, so we will have less support for him!" Ouyang Yue said.
"Well, this is reasonable! I just don't know if my husband needs our help now!" Nie Xiaoqian said with a smile.
"Of course! I really need your help!" Xiao Tian's voice also sounded from outside the door.
Hearing this, the four women also stood up excitedly. Then they all looked towards the door.
When Xiao Tian's figure walked in, the four women also rushed up and threw themselves into Xiao Tian's arms.
"Husband, why do you have time to come here!" Chen Rongqian said with a smile.
"Hehe... Of course I sensed that you missed me, and then I came!" Xiao Tian said with a smile.
"My husband likes to joke more and more now." Ouyang Yue also said with a smile.
"No! What I said is absolutely true! If you don't believe it, just touch it!" After Xiao Tian finished speaking, he took Ouyang Yue's little hand and put it on his chest.
This action instantly made Ouyang Yue's face turn red.
The other women also looked at Xiao Tian with a smile...
